title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish, inspired by Indian cuisine, featuring pork dumplings in a rich and flavorful sauce.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and warm water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of pork filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the pan and cook until golden brown on both sides.
Remove the dumplings from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add onion, garlic, and ginger.
Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the crushed tomatoes, curry powder, salt, and black pepper.
Return the dumplings to the pan and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot with the rich and flavorful sauce.
